note: Eau Claire County campground on the east shore of Coon Fork Lake, 4 mi east of Augusta. Loop D (water and electric) takes self-contained units only. The lakeside sites in loops A-C sit under pines with a shoreline trail between them and the water. Two swimming beaches, a boat landing and two camper cabins. --Claude
summary: County page, Konect Parks site list, 2026 campground map and policies, and the county camping page read. 108 sites in four loops, about 56 electric (not only A and D), water+electric at all 20 loop D sites, showers/dump. Reservable online, walk-ins at the office in season; year-round with off-season self-registration in A and D. Phone 715-286-5536 -> 715-975-0000. Lakeview kept. Pin is at the entrance/registration station; re-pin proposed ~340 m to the loops.
flags: WATERFRONT: lakeview kept (no --AWH). The 24 lakeside sites, sold by the night at $27 (A4, A6, A7, A9, A11, A13, A14, A15, A18, A19; B2, B4, B6, B8, B9, B11, B13; C2, C4, C5, C7, C8, C11, C12), line the east shore around 44.6985,-91.0140 to 44.6930,-91.0110. On Esri imagery and the county drone photos the shore is a continuous band of pines, with the trail running between the pads and the water. No pad shows open ground to the shore within about 50 m.
